headline: Ten numbered builds. Patent pending. The first purchase orders are out, and deposits are opening to the waitlist first.

stages.title: Parts on order
stages.note: The first purchase orders went out August 20 - wheels, sprockets, shafts, and steering parts are on order from the batch suppliers. Frame fabrication is next.

stages.title: Taking deposits
stages.note: A $500 deposit holds a numbered build slot, fully refundable until you approve your final invoice. The waitlist gets first access, in signup order - the deposit link goes to the list directly, not this page.

stages.title: In production
stages.note: Frames welded at a professional fabrication shop, then every cart is built by John in slot order - same hands that built the prototype. Each one gets a serial number and a recorded test before it leaves.

stages.title: Delivering
stages.note: Hand-delivered by John, Maine to New Jersey, in build-slot order.

slots.label: Cart #1 — shop cart, not for sale. Built first, on camera.

footnote: This page is updated when something real happens, and only then.
